verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.recruitee.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a documentation index. It instructs agents to append .md to any page URL for markdown, and a second probe confirms .md pages are served and point back to the llms.txt index. The llms.txt content itself enumerates API endpoints such as candidate creation, listing and offers. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and any independent user corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.recruitee.com/llms.txt # Recruitee Documentation
Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown v
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.recruitee.com/llms.
Calling this endpoint will return a collection of the company's candidates.
